request.description:
First registration step: Update shop details.

Updates:
- Shop name, category, property type
- Email and verifies email OTP status
- Shop location (address, city, pincode, lat/long)
- Business proof type and document
- Shop photos (inside/outside)

Sets:
- currentRegistrationStep = "SHOP_DETAILS"
- registrationStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
- isEmailVerified = true/false (based on email OTP)

response.name: Success Response

formdata.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (Required)
Alternative field for date of birth

request.description:
Second registration step: Update personal/about details.

Updates:
- Full name, father's name
- Date of birth
- Gender, marital status
- Educational qualification (plain text)
- Selfie photo

Sets:
- currentRegistrationStep = "ABOUT"
- registrationStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"

request.description:
Third registration step: Update Aadhaar details.

Updates:
- Aadhaar number (12 digits)
- Aadhaar consent status
- Mobile linked to Aadhaar status
- Aadhaar document photo

Sets:
- currentRegistrationStep = "AADHAAR_DETAILS"
- registrationStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"

request.description:
Fourth and final registration step: Update bank details and onboard merchant.

Updates:
- Bank name, IFSC code, account number
- Stores as array with isPrimary=true, isActive=true

External API Call:
- Calls /aeps5/bank5/onboard with all user data
- Receives and stores outletId

Sets:
- currentRegistrationStep = "SUBMITTED"
- registrationStatus = "COMPLETED"
- adminApproved = "pending"
- outletId from provider

This completes the registration process!
